assumptions.backend-affected: frozen profiles v1/v2/v3 and evidence-v2 byte-identical and untouched
assumptions.dialogue: 20% 16-turn, remaining 4-12; local authored banks; within-trip timing synthetic
assumptions.dialogue_holdout: bank templates partitioned 70/15/15; paraphrase affixes raise surface uniqueness
assumptions.enums: cancellation reason/actor drawn from overlapping operational pools; not label-deterministic
assumptions.fare: completed fare = 12k VND + 12k VND/km capped at 100k/km; cancelled trips carry no charge
assumptions.geography: 20% Porto anchors from licensed observed taxi template; synthetic geometry, not shortest-road evidence
assumptions.gridlock: 10% honest; 3% of gridlock controlled SSD boundary fixtures from synthetic 400-trip calibration, not real traffic frequency
assumptions.history: only earlier terminal operational events; no current/future outcome or labels; profile priors separate
assumptions.kinematics: measured Porto pooled quantiles include stops; linear p05-p95 interpolation and [3,24] moving clipping assumptions; crawl/teleport scenario priors
assumptions.labels: enriched synthetic class mix; evidence sufficiency remains independent; no existing cases relabeled
assumptions.locale: per-trip city/country/locale metadata agrees with telemetry bbox
assumptions.noise: 10% stress; AR1 rho=0.9 and accuracy/noise priors are synthetic assumptions; boundary subset excludes stress
assumptions.splits: stable driver hash 70/15/15; no holdout tuning and no claim of unseen-driver generalization

gates.gate: fare coherence (no fare on cancelled, per-km<=100k)
